message: Here is a 5-slide deck on your regional sales performance. No data source is connected, so the figures are left to fill in. Connecting a source with revenue by region and by month would help.

deck_spec.title: Regional Sales Performance
deck_spec.purpose: Review regional sales performance and agree one action per region
deck_spec.argument: Revenue differs by region and month, and seeing the differences side by side shows where to focus next quarter
deck_spec.call_to_action: Agree one action per region for next quarter

gaps: No regional sales figures are connected: revenue by region and month

slides.purpose: Open the review and frame the question: where is regional sales performance strong?
slides.content_brief: Title slide with the deck title 'Regional Sales Performance' and a subtitle saying that revenue differs by region and the review shows where
slides.assumes: The audience knows its own regions
slides.hands_off: The regional picture builds toward one action each

slides.content_brief: A chart-plus-commentary slide comparing revenue by region, with a one-line takeaway on the strongest and weakest region. Revenue figures are to be supplied
slides.assumes: The audience knows its own regions
slides.hands_off: The regional picture builds toward one action each

slides.purpose: Show how each region moves month by month
slides.content_brief: Three bullets on the monthly pattern per region, with a callout on the region that moves most. Monthly figures are to be supplied
slides.assumes: The audience knows its own regions
slides.hands_off: The regional picture builds toward one action each

slides.purpose: Draw out what the regional differences mean
slides.content_brief: Three short bullets on what the differences imply for focus and investment
slides.assumes: The audience knows its own regions
slides.hands_off: The regional picture builds toward one action each

slides.content_brief: Ask the leadership team to agree one action per region for next quarter
slides.assumes: The audience knows its own regions
slides.hands_off: The regional picture builds toward one action each
